title: Order of Operations with Powers and Integers
introduction: Consolidate primary mathematics and prepare for secondary study through order of operations with powers and integers.
definition: Evaluate brackets first, then powers, then multiplication and division from left to right, followed by addition and subtraction from left to right. A negative sign outside a power is different from a negative base enclosed in brackets.
